task: AI-guided inverse-design framework for recyclable vitrimeric polymers
named_methods: molecular dynamics Tg simulations as input observations
Gaussian-process calibration of MD Tg to experimental Tg
graph variational autoencoder for candidate generation
inverse design targeting desired glass transition temperatures

available_workspace_inputs.tg_calibration.csv: polymer SMILES, experimental Tg, MD Tg, MD uncertainty/std
available_workspace_inputs.tg_vitrimer_MD.csv: acid and epoxide component SMILES for vitrimer systems, MD Tg, MD uncertainty/std

implemented_plan.calibration: Train/test GaussianProcessRegressor using MD Tg, MD std, and deterministic SMILES/string-derived molecular descriptors; evaluate held-out experimental Tg prediction.
implemented_plan.vitrimer_prediction: Apply GP calibration to vitrimer acid+epoxide systems to obtain calibrated Tg mean and uncertainty.
implemented_plan.inverse_design: Learn a descriptor-space generative latent model from vitrimer components and screen recombined acid/epoxide chemistries by calibrated Tg target proximity and uncertainty.
implemented_plan.graph_vae: Attempt exact dependency check; if unavailable, implement a graph-inspired descriptor latent generative fallback and explicitly mark non-exact graph VAE fidelity.
implemented_plan.experimental_validation: No new experiments can be performed in this workspace; provide a prioritized experimental validation panel with predicted Tg and uncertainty for synthesis/testing.

primary_targets: candidate ranking for target Tg windows
held-out calibration error and uncertainty calibration
